title: Warm Bouncy Irish Potato Hash
description: A hearty and satisfying Irish dish featuring crispy potatoes and a side of bacon, perfect for a brunch gathering. This gluten-free friendly recipe is sure to please.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the diced potatoes with 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder until they are evenly coated.
Spread the potatoes out in a single layer on a baking sheet and broil for 20 minutes, flipping them halfway through.
While the potatoes are cooking, cook the diced bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the bacon from the skillet with a slotted spoon and set aside on a paper towel lined plate.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Once the potatoes are done, remove them from the oven and add them to the skillet with the onion.
Stir in the cooked bacon and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the potato hash hot, garnished with chopped scallions if desired.
